caption: Gaussian benchmark: N=1,2,3, seven finite target defect-intensity SNRs (0,10,20,30,40,60,80 dB) and one noiseless control, five methods, 200 paired trials per condition (24000 method-level records). (b-d) Exact-support rates and pointwise 95% Wilson intervals. (a) N=2, seven finite SNRs only: defect NRMSE medians and IQR, all 200 observations including incorrect-support outputs; 7000 method-level records. The noiseless control occupies a separated final column and is not connected to finite SNR in (b-d); (a) has an unbroken logarithmic error axis and no noiseless point. All displayed quartiles are within the axis limits. All NRMSE observations are available; no exceptions or zero imputation. Methods use the same frames within each trial.
